# Azure Functions

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/resourcemanager/appservice/armappservice/v6@v6.0.0` · last audited 2026-11-05 (`959104c86`)

### Known gaps

- Bundle-extension triggers other than timer, queue, blob, Service Bus and Event Hubs (Cosmos DB, Event Grid and the rest) are not exercised against a real host (triggers_docker_test.go).
- Not implemented: VNet integration, custom domains and certificates, easy auth (authsettings are stored only); Flex Consumption deployment.storage is validated but not used as the package store, and alwaysReady, maximumInstanceCount and perInstanceConcurrency have no runtime effect.
- Deployment slots: no slot-level custom domains (custom domains are not implemented); slotsdiffs does not list the sticky-setting changes of the preview phases; only the swapped settings that differ are reported.
- Web apps: Tomcat, JBoss, Ruby and Go stacks are rejected because the supported version matrix is not published on Learn (it comes from az webapp list-runtimes); Windows web apps, multi-container (sitecontainers) and docker-compose apps are rejected with 400.
